verdict.rationale: Gemini Apps documents scheduling recurring actions on daily, weekly and monthly cadences that run automatically and return results, such as a daily news digest. This satisfies the 'recurring or one-off' story through its recurring branch. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off scheduled tasks, documentation of how results are delivered or notified, any management or editing of scheduled actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions. For example, you can schedule actions in Gemini Apps to get: A daily news digest on topics that matter most to you
